agent_constraints: Do not invent a fourth teammate or outside expert.
Record model assumptions, data provenance, validation, and limitations in shared memory.
Use independent review before the final PDF and disclose AI use under the applicable edition rules.

information_policy.coordination_requirement: Communicate decisions and evidence explicitly; shared artifacts and citations are recorded in scratchpad/work, while private reasoning remains private.

simulation.turn_budget_basis: Bounded long-horizon proxy; not a literal 99-hour clock.

advice_scope: time allocation within the rule card

opening_discussion.purpose: Coach exits permanently after the single turn-0 blind brief.

competition_format: Work as one registered ICM team of at most three students from the same school. Select and solve one released ICM problem, document assumptions, models, validation, sensitivity, conclusions, and sources, and submit one PDF solution report. Do not obtain solution help from anyone outside the team. Follow the edition-specific AI-use and disclosure requirements and do not fabricate citations or data provenance.
timeline: The current published 2027 window is Thursday 5:00 p.m. through Monday 8:00 p.m. EST (99 hours), followed by the electronic submission deadline. Historical packets may have edition-specific dates.
collaboration_protocol: Only registered team members may work on the solution.
integrity_and_compliance: Work as one registered ICM team of at most three students from the same school. Select and solve one released ICM problem, document assumptions, models, validation, sensitivity, conclusions, and sources, and submit one PDF solution report. Do not obtain solution help from anyone outside the team. Follow the edition-specific AI-use and disclosure requirements and do not fabricate citations or data provenance.
deliverable_format: One modeling solution report with references and required disclosure material.
evaluation_criteria: Evaluate the final PDF as a modeling report. Keep report quality, rule compliance, source integrity, and collaboration diagnostics separate; do not equate a rubric score with a COMAP award designation.
runtime_limitations: Official multi-day wall-clock execution is represented by a bounded agent-turn budget.
Historical rows retain their problem statements but use a current proxy collaboration card unless an edition card is added.
